_readme: Hand-authored opinion modifiers ONLY -- treaty-derived opinion is now computed live in strategic-map.js from all_info/treaties.json + treaty_types.json.opinionValue (mirrored to both directions per treaty edge), not stored here. Use this file for narrative one-offs a GM wants to layer on top: betrayals, favors, insults, escalations, etc. Shape: opinions[fromFamily][toFamily] = [{label, value}, ...], directional, summed with everything else in the family overlay opinions list.
